title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #6

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a result of sin? (1 mark)
   A. It brings health
   B. It separates us from God
   C. It brings peace
   D. It brings praise

2. When were the ten men healed? (1 mark)
   A. After many years
   B. As they went
   C. Before they heard Him
   D. Never

3. Who helps believers to show the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. The neighbour
   B. The Holy Spirit
   C. The market
   D. The king

4. Which verse says that those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion? (1 mark)
   A. Psalm 125:1
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. John 3:16

5. Which fruit is shown by keeping a promise? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Faithfulness
   C. Envy
   D. Selfishness

6. Why did Jesus tell the parables in Luke 15? (1 mark)
   A. To teach farming
   B. Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   C. To praise money
   D. To entertain

7. Where was Joseph when the cupbearer remembered him? (1 mark)
   A. In the palace
   B. In Canaan
   C. In prison
   D. In his father's house

8. What did Jesus ask about the other nine? (1 mark)
   A. Who healed them?
   B. Where are the other nine?
   C. Why were they sick?
   D. Who are they?

9. What did Jesus say to the young man? (1 mark)
   A. Go away
   B. Young man, I say to you, get up
   C. Be quiet
   D. Follow me

10. Which book of the Bible begins with the words "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"? (1 mark)
   A. Psalms
   B. Luke
   C. Genesis
   D. Exodus

11. Which question helps you to choose rightly? (1 mark)
   A. Will I get away with it?
   B. Who will laugh at me?
   C. What is the cheapest?
   D. Does this agree with what God teaches?

12. Which is a poetry and wisdom book in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus
   B. Isaiah
   C. Joshua
   D. Psalms

13. If someone says they love you but hurts you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell a trusted adult
   B. Keep it secret
   C. Hurt them
   D. Ignore it

14. Who taught the disciples the Lord's Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Moses
   B. Peter
   C. Jesus
   D. John

15. What does Ephesians 4:26 teach about anger? (1 mark)
   A. Always hit back
   B. Never feel angry
   C. Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   D. Keep anger for a week

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain four ways of showing responsibility at school. (4 marks)

17. Explain what the word "sole" means when we say God is the sole Creator. (3 marks)

18. Give two reasons why we should not take revenge. (2 marks)

19. Give three ways of avoiding situations that lead to sin. (3 marks)

20. Give three examples of how a child can show self-control at school. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It separates us from God
   Sin harms us and others.

2. B — As they went
   Luke 17:14 says they were cleansed as they went.

3. B — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit grows the fruit.

4. A — Psalm 125:1
   Psalm 125:1 gives this picture.

5. B — Faithfulness
   Faithfulness is loyalty.

6. B — Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   Jesus showed God's love for sinners.

7. C — In prison
   Joseph was in prison in Egypt.

8. B — Where are the other nine?
   Luke 17:17 records the question.

9. B — Young man, I say to you, get up
   Luke 7:14 records this command.

10. C — Genesis
   Genesis 1:1 is the opening line of the Bible.

11. D — Does this agree with what God teaches?
   We measure choices by God's word.

12. D — Psalms
   Psalms, Proverbs and Job are among the poetry and wisdom books.

13. A — Tell a trusted adult
   Love is never hurtful.

14. C — Jesus
   Jesus taught it when asked.

15. C — Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   The verse says that we should not sin when angry and should settle it quickly.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep the class clean, take care of books, obey rules, do assigned duties, return borrowed things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sole means only. God alone made everything. Nobody helped Him and nobody made Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of sole, 1 for God alone creating, 1 for no helper.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: It starts a cycle of hurt; it gets us in trouble; it breaks friendships; it displeases God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose good friends, avoid wrong places, be careful about what you watch, keep busy with good things, pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for your turn, do not fight, do homework first, do not shout, do not copy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.
